[Daily Dose of Grammar Skills Weekly Outline, Day 71-74] Homophones, contraction, subject, sentence construction

[Unit 3 Writing Rope lesson, Georgia Standard(s) Addressed] STANDARD 3-5.L.GC.1: Grammar, Usage, & Mechanics
[Unit 3 Writing Rope lesson (10/26/26-12/18/26), I DO Think-Aloud] The teacher will display narrative techniques and how techniques such as setting and dialogue are incorporated in the text.
[Unit 3 Writing Rope lesson, WE DO Prompts] What is a setting in narrative writing? What is dialogue in narrative writing?
[Unit 3 Writing Rope lesson, Georgia Standard(s) Addressed] 5.T.T.1.a Analyze the use of narrative techniques to present ideas, design texts, and convey information about characters, setting, and plot.
